tests.code: let mut r = Ring::<u8, 2>::new(); let (mut p, mut c) = r.split(); assert_eq!(c.pop(), None); assert_eq!(p.push(1), Ok(())); assert_eq!(p.push(2), Ok(())); assert_eq!(p.push(3), Err(3)); assert_eq!(c.pop(), Some(1)); assert_eq!(p.push(3), Ok(())); assert_eq!(c.pop(), Some(2)); assert_eq!(c.pop(), Some(3)); assert_eq!(c.pop(), None);

let a = std::sync::Arc::new(()); { let mut r = Ring::<_, 4>::new(); let (mut p, mut c) = r.split(); for _ in 0..3 { assert!(p.push(a.clone()).is_ok()); } drop(c.pop()); assert_eq!(std::sync::Arc::strong_count(&a), 3); } assert_eq!(std::sync::Arc::strong_count(&a), 1);

let mut r = Ring::<u32, 8>::new(); let (mut p, mut c) = r.split(); let got = thread::scope(|s| { s.spawn(move || { for mut v in 0..20_000u32 { while let Err(b) = p.push(v) { v = b; thread::yield_now(); } } }); let mut out = Vec::new(); while out.len() < 20_000 { match c.pop() { Some(v) => out.push(v), None => thread::yield_now() } } out }); assert!(got.iter().enumerate().all(|(i, v)| i as u32 == *v));
